verdict.rationale: Proton Pass is a password manager with built-in TOTP generation, so this axis applies. The pack only shows standard TOTP code generation. It has no evidence of Steam Guard tokens, HOTP counter-based codes, or configurable periods and digit lengths, and generic TOTP support does not cover these non-standard token types.

support.subject: As a power user, non-standard tokens work too — Steam Guard, HOTP counters, custom periods and digit lengths
